description: Synthetic ground truth for the redaction evaluation (metrics 2/3). Every item declares the detector expected to find it, because the three sources are found by different layers and scoring one detector against another's items produces phantom failures.

sources.text: Visible page text — modules/pii/regex.ts detectRegexPii(). Scored by scripts/evaluate-full.mjs.
sources.input: A form control's value attribute — not visible in page text, so a text regex can never see it. Found by detectSensitiveInputs() and neutralised by the value-redaction path. Scored by scripts/e2e-leak.test.mjs (needs a DOM).
sources.selector: Inferred from the element's attributes, value unknown to any text scan.
sources.ml: Requires the on-device model (NER / yolos-tiny). Scored by the browser e2e.

groundTruth.note: The word 'password' in a label is NOT PII and must not be redacted; only the field's value is.
Cardholder name in a type=text input at line 38 — the canonical raw-PII leak case. Also appears in page text at lines 25 and 54.

totals.note: sensitiveInputs = email, password, tel, cc-number (the four controls whose values must never leave the device).

excluded.reason: The page prints its own answer key. Scanning it inflates apparent recall — it was previously counted as detections, roughly a third of the total.

notes: Metric 2 text recall: node scripts/evaluate-full.mjs. Metric 2 input/selector/ML + raw-PII leak assertions: node scripts/e2e-leak.test.mjs (headless Chrome). Metric 3 bbox IoU: greedy 1:1 matching in modules/pii/redactor.ts and POST /api/evaluate/redaction.
